traditional: A hard contact. Action, conflict, and heat works against limitation, delay, and hard structure - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas. Two malefics in a hard aspect: handle with care, and worse when either is out of sect.
modern: Drive meets limit. Disciplined endurance and the ability to pace yourself and keep going long after others quit. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Gas and brake at once: jerky, stop-start progress, frustration, and a need to avoid burning bridges in case of retreat. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for drive against limit, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the drive/limit form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Endurance and discipline; the friction is the constant start-stop of push against restraint.
shadow: Anger and recklessness collides with fear and rigidity; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: Momentum meets resistance when action runs into rules, deadlines, delays, or limits that will not move on demand.

readerCopy.body: Momentum meets resistance when action runs into rules, deadlines, delays, or limits that will not move on demand. When Mars squares Saturn, the push to act can make every constraint feel like a personal obstruction even when the restriction is simply part of the structure. More force is unlikely to make a fixed limit disappear. The useful question is which constraint is fixed, which one can change, and where effort can still produce movement.
